Definition / Acceptance Rule: Stable internal identifier for each external offer, ad, survey, game or payout provider.
Generate an immutable internal launch/activity ID before redirecting or opening provider content.
Persist provider callback ID and server receipt timestamp; retain raw payload securely with restricted access.
Verify callback signature/token using provider-approved mechanism before accepting status or value.
Resolve callback to the internal user and originating activity; reject ambiguous matches to quarantine.
Enforce uniqueness on provider_id + provider_event_id (or documented fallback key); retries must not create duplicate reward.
Maintain versioned mapping from provider-specific statuses to canonical pending/approved/rejected/reversed/unknown states.
Validate required identifiers, permitted status transitions, amount/unit bounds and event age; invalid records go to quarantine.
Only the authoritative reward ledger confirms a credit; provider callback alone is not proof of wallet credit.
Failure / Risk Addressed: Inflated earnings; callback mistaken for payment.

Definition / Acceptance Rule: Reconcile provider reports/callbacks against internal activity and reward ledger on an agreed cadence.
Failure / Risk Addressed: Lost, duplicated or mismatched provider activity.

Definition / Acceptance Rule: Define provider-specific timeout and escalation; no callback must remain pending/unknown, not auto-success.
Link reversals/disputes to original activity and reward; preserve immutable history.
Monitor receipt latency, signature failures, unmatched callbacks, duplicate attempts, quarantine and reconciliation breaks.
Version provider contracts/mappings; test in staging and document cutover and rollback.
Failure / Risk Addressed: Breaking schema changes; silent metric drift.
